title: Rear screen (LCD) at 3:2 in movie mode with the focus frames: VDF fills the 3:2 panel with the 16:9 live view, and the two frame widgets expect the live view there (A6700 2.00)
artifact: cpapp-b.bin 2.00 (ILCE-6700), its loaded image in coprocessor RAM: the words are in the file, the change is made in RAM only

ported_from.note: works on an A7 IV (F791, F969); the ZV-E1's lcdfill_zv_v2 is the same two-table form

contributed: the 5 sites equal the contributed lcdfill_a6700_v2's (work/contrib/a6700_v1.0), and each of its 7 guards is covered by one of these 10 (same address, the same bytes; its 8-byte guard at 0x1f61a4 is 16 bytes here)
table: VDF fit-mode table 0x1f5f98 (function 0x1f5f48 = A7 IV 0x1e4b78) and the frame widgets' rectangle tables 0xe99e30 (cpActAfWindow) and 0xe99e90 (cpActTrackingFrame): 3 rows x 4 aspect columns, entry row 1 (rear 3:2 panel), column 3 (16:9)

summary.panel: rear LCD, 3:2 (panel code 1 from type byte 3 at RAM 0x1a7c0e0, expected)
summary.viewfinder: unchanged: a 4:3 panel (panel code 0) keeps the 16:9 letterbox and shows the squeezed frame, as on the A7 IV

while_applied: every 16:9 picture on the rear screen is stretched over the 3:2 panel (other movie formats and 16:9 playback look wrong there until the step is put back); the viewfinder and HDMI are unchanged
not_shown: anything on a camera by us (the contributor reports the rear screen filled with working focus and tracking frames)

the rear panel type byte 0x1a7c0e0 (expected 3 = 3:2 from Sony's 1,036,800 dots = 720 x 480; a dump should read it): if it says 2 (4:3) the fit word is not read and the screen stays letterboxed, as on the A7S III with lcdfill_s3_v1
that the frame widgets use row 1 on this body (a model word; carried over from the A7 IV)

sites.note: VDF fit mode for a 16:9 picture on a 3:2 panel (table 0x1f5f98 for picture code 2, entry for panel code 1): 3 letterbox to 0 fill. The rear screen then stretches the 16:9 live view over the whole 3:2 panel [A7 IV 0x1e4bcc]
cpActAfWindow (focus area frames), check 0x128438: expected live-view rectangle for a 16:9 picture on the rear 3:2 panel (row 1, column 3), x, y: stock (0, 38, 640, 404) to (0, 0, 640, 480)
cpActAfWindow (focus area frames), check 0x128438: expected live-view rectangle for a 16:9 picture on the rear 3:2 panel (row 1, column 3), w, h: stock (0, 38, 640, 404) to (0, 0, 640, 480)

cpActTrackingFrame (tracking and face frames), check 0x129288: expected live-view rectangle for a 16:9 picture on the rear 3:2 panel (row 1, column 3), x, y: stock (0, 38, 640, 404) to (0, 0, 640, 480)
